posts.author: dim7ay
posts.body:
Messages done simply!
This tool allows you to export a map's event messages to a .txt file and modify them to your liking. Useful for spell checking, message, name editing, and game localizations. You may also edit the text with your own little programs. Works as far as I know for both RPG Maker MV and MZ maps. Enjoy!
